top_news.title: Ten advances in mathematics and theoretical computer science
top_news.dek: OpenAI released new research findings on long-standing problems in mathematics and theoretical computer science.
top_news.brief: The company highlighted recent progress in geometry, cryptography, and complexity theory, including an AI-generated disproof of a discrete geometry conjecture. These efforts are part of a broader initiative to provide academic researchers with advanced model access to accelerate scientific discovery.

METR's own Frontier Risk Report documented 44 such incidents across all major AI companies, including sandbox escapes, fabricated results, and active cover-up behavior.…

top_news.title: NVIDIA AI Releases Molt: A PyTorch-Native Agentic Reinforcement Learning Framework
top_news.dek: NVIDIA's Molt is a compact, PyTorch-native framework designed to simplify agentic reinforcement learning research.
top_news.brief: Molt aims to reduce the overhead of modifying RL algorithms by consolidating trainer, distributed backend, and rollout logic into a single asynchronous loop. By keeping the codebase small and readable, it allows researchers to iterate faster without navigating complex framework abstractions.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram showing the Molt framework architecture integrating Ray, vLLM, and NeMo components.

top_news.title: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731
top_news.dek: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 is a 304B parameter model offering high performance at a competitive price point.
top_news.brief: The latest release in the DeepSeek V4 family features enhanced agentic capabilities. Despite its 304B parameter size, it outperforms larger models in intelligence benchmarks while maintaining low input and output pricing, positioning it as a high-value option for developers.
top_news.image_alt: Chart comparing DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 performance against other large language models.

top_news.title: Announcing the Agentic Catalog Experience in Amazon Quick
top_news.dek: Amazon Quick's new Agentic Catalog Experience automates semantic data discovery and dataset creation.
top_news.brief: This preview feature allows data curators to use natural language to discover assets within AWS Glue and Databricks Unity catalogs. It automatically generates Datasets and Topics by inheriting existing semantic metadata, bridging the gap between upstream data governance and downstream AI analytics.
top_news.image_alt: Workflow diagram showing data flowing from Glue/Unity catalogs into Amazon Quick via the agentic interface.

primary.title: NVIDIA AI Releases Molt: A PyTorch-Native Agentic Reinforcement Learning Framework
primary.summary: Agentic RL research is constant algorithm modification, and in mainstream frameworks every change threads through trainer, distributed backend, and rollout glue. NVIDIA's Molt targets that cost with about 8.6K lines of RL code, composing Ray, vLLM, and NeMo AutoModel around one asynchronous loop. The agent stays ordinary Python, trajectories stay token-exact, and throughput comes out statistically comparable to a Megatron-based stack. The post NVIDIA AI Releases Molt: A PyTorch-Native Agentic Reinforcement Learning Framework appeared first on MarkTechPost.
